memories.author: D05
memories.text: Dyslipidaemia, hypothyroidism, allergic rhinitis. Patient reports fatigue, mild weight gain, and occasional nasal congestion. On examination, BMI 27 kg/m2, thyroid not enlarged, nasal mucosa pale and edematous. Smoking status: never. Lipid profile and thyroid function pending.

memories.author: D05
memories.text:
atorvastatin 10 mg HS
levothyroxine 50 mcg OD
cetirizine 10 mg HS
fluticasone nasal spray, one spray each nostril OD
montelukast 10 mg HS

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 162 mg/dL (opt <100), HDL 38 mg/dL (>40), triglycerides 210 mg/dL (<150). Liver function: ALT 28 U/L (7-56), AST 24 U/L (10-40), ALKP 78 U/L (40-129), GGT 32 U/L (9-64). Creatine kinase 112 U/L (30-200). TSH 5.8 mIU/L (0.4-4.0). Free T4 11.2 pmol/L (12-22).

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Allergy to house dust mite: perennial sneezing, nasal itching, watery eyes on exposure; confirmed by skin prick test wheal 8 mm.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Stable dyslipidaemia on statin, subclinical hypothyroidism, allergic rhinitis controlled. Patient notes improved energy, occasional daytime sleepiness, nasal congestion worse in mornings. Exam: BMI 26.8, thyroid non-tender, nasal mucosa mildly erythematous. Smoking status: never.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Fasting lipid profile: LDL 118 mg/dL, HDL 40 mg/dL, triglycerides 165 mg/dL. Liver function: ALT 22, AST 20, ALKP 75, GGT 30. TSH 3.9 mIU/L, Free T4 13.5 pmol/L.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: ECG: sinus rhythm 78 bpm, no ST‑T changes, no Q waves. Normal study.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Referral to cardiology for further lipid‑lowering strategy and cardiovascular risk assessment.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Cardiology review: LDL remains elevated, recommend adding fenofibrate. No cardiac ischemia detected. Advise lifestyle optimisation.

memories.author: D05
memories.text: Persistent hypertriglyceridaemia, euthyroid on levothyroxine, allergic rhinitis well controlled. Patient reports mild myalgia after statin, good nasal symptom control. Exam: BMI 26.5, no muscle tenderness, nasal mucosa pink. Smoking status: never.

memories.text: Via app: ‘My nose feels blocked again in the evenings and I sneeze when I clean the house. Should I increase the nasal spray?’
